hypothesesToMeasure: Four factories share scarce physical oil transport; fewer nearby factories may reach readiness earlier with lower paid construction cost.
Four oil trucks and two tankers may serve the material bottleneck better than three of each, within the same six-support cap.
A first attack on a visible nearer enemy threat may permit a useful earlier sortie than the full enemy-HQ round trip.
